newsitem.title: USA: American General to acquire Home Beneficial - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: American General to acquire Home Beneficial - WSJ.

text.p: American General Corp is expected to announce on Monday an agreement to pay $665 million, or $39 per share, for Home Beneficial Corp, The Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
The development is the latest sign of life insurance industry consolidation, the story says.
American General has been one of the most aggressive consolidators, the story says.

The transaction would be its third in two years, for a total consideration of $2.2 billion, and would further solidify the company's position as one of the nation's five biggest life insurers on the basis of sales, the story says.

The cash and stock acquisition of Home Beneficial is designed to boost earnings growth and gain economies of scale at a time when sales of conventional life insurance policies are falling for many companies, the Journal reported.
